name: tenement-summary
title: Tenement summary
for_each: select id, ref from tenements order by ref

sections.title: The tenement
sections.sql: select ref, type, project, status, location, applied_on as applied, granted_on as granted, expires_on as expires, ended_on as ended, area, area_unit, tenement_year from tenement_register where id = $1

sections.title: Holders
sections.sql: select h.name as holder, trim_scale(i.pct) || '%' as share, i.nature, i.from_on as from, i.to_on as to from interests i join holders h on h.id = i.holder_id where i.tenement_id = $1 order by i.from_on, i.pct desc

sections.title: Commitment and spend
sections.sql: select year_started, year_ends, commitment_cents as commitment, spent_this_year_cents as spent_this_year, spent_last_year_cents as spent_last_year from tenement_spend where id = $1

sections.title: Dates
sections.sql: select c.item, c.due_on as due, coalesce(c.done_on::text, 'open') as done from tenement_calendar c where c.tenement_id = $1 order by c.due_on

sections.title: Form 5s lodged
sections.sql: select year_ending, lodged_on, to_char(reported_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as reported, receipt from form5_reports where tenement_id = $1 order by year_ending desc

sections.title: Conditions
sections.sql: select number, text from conditions where tenement_id = $1 order by number
sections.note: The record for the board, a joint venture partner or a buyer's due diligence. Check it against the department's register.

name: project-expenditure
title: Project expenditure statement
for_each: select id, code from projects order by code

sections.title: The project
sections.sql: select code, name, region, combined_reporting, manager from projects where id = $1

sections.title: Each tenement this year
sections.sql: select s.ref, s.year_started, s.year_ends, s.commitment_cents as commitment, s.spent_this_year_cents as spent from tenement_spend s join tenements t on t.id = s.id where t.project_id = $1 order by s.ref

sections.title: Spend by category, last 12 months
sections.sql: select c.name as category, to_char(sum(e.amount_cents) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as spent, count(*)::int as entries from expenditure e join tenements t on t.id = e.tenement_id join expenditure_categories c on c.code = e.category where t.project_id = $1 and e.spent_on > current_date - 365 group by c.name order by sum(e.amount_cents) desc
sections.note: A working statement for a combined Form 5, a farm-in partner or the board. Keep the invoices behind each line.

name: asx-schedule
title: ASX quarterly tenement schedule
for_each: select code as id, code from asx_quarters order by code

sections.title: Tenements held at the end of the quarter
sections.sql: select t.ref as tenement, t.location, trim_scale(group_interest(t.id, q.starts_on - 1)) || '%' as interest_at_start, trim_scale(group_interest(t.id, q.ends_on)) || '%' as interest_at_end, case when t.granted_on is null or t.granted_on > q.ends_on then 'application' else 'granted' end as status from asx_quarters q cross join tenements t where q.code = $1 and coalesce(t.granted_on, t.applied_on) <= q.ends_on and (t.ended_on is null or t.ended_on > q.ends_on) and group_interest(t.id, q.ends_on) > 0 order by t.ref

sections.title: Tenements disposed of during the quarter
sections.sql: select t.ref as tenement, t.location, t.status, t.ended_on from asx_quarters q cross join tenements t where q.code = $1 and t.ended_on between q.starts_on and q.ends_on order by t.ref
sections.note: ASX Listing Rule 5.3.3. Check every line against the department's register before release.
